tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: Already-judged public examples. No absolute seal. No account.

tools.name: read_verdict
tools.description: Read one item. seal is always null. Without judges, headline is the neutral status and judges lists who agreed (wire stance authentic). Pass judges (node id or pubkey) and an optional threshold to read that circle. Headlines: Your circle agrees (n of m), Your circle disregards it, Not settled yet. A

tools.name: submit_claim
tools.description: Submit a text claim, or a photo/document by SHA-256 or IPFS CID. No http(s) URLs. Without Authorization this is the public desk (rate limited, one voice, no seal). With Authorization: Bot <token>, same rules as POST /api/v1/items (signed bulletin cercle.vote/1, or a key the relay already holds).

tools.name: vote
tools.description: Record a signed stance on an existing item. Wire values stay authentic (agree, counted) or fabricated (optional, not counted toward ratification, and not the app Ignore button). Requires Authorization: Bot <token>. One stance per judge. A signed reply is free (no quota). Tool name stays vote.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_claim" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
